Annddddd Movim 0.35.5 is out! ✨

In this release, three important fixes related to message edition, emoji reactions and incoming articles handling on the network 😬

We are happy to also introduce a brand new Docker image made by one of our contributors! @dewiq@mastodon.social 📦

And finally some old Javascript code, related to images and files upload and manipulation were refactored and modernized.

You can find all the details on the release note on our blog: https://mov.im/community/pubsub.movim.eu/Movim/movim-0-35-5-more-fixes-and-improvements-VFMKSB

And don't forget to update and share the good news around 😸!
